items.text: Tracey Schroeder is an elementary school teacher in the Los Angeles Unified School District with over 25 years of experience. She holds a bachelor’s degree from UCLA and a master’s degree from Phillips Graduate Institute.

sentences.text: Tracey Schroeder is an elementary school teacher in the Los Angeles Unified School District with over 25 years of experience.
She holds a bachelor’s degree from UCLA and a master’s degree from Phillips Graduate Institute.

items.text: Her campaign says she would vote to suspend the state gas tax, use budget surpluses to cut taxes, and defend Proposition 13, while opposing any new tax increases. She has expressed concern about crime, open-air drug use, and the slow rebuilding effort after the Palisades fire. She calls for tougher penalties for repeat offenders, a state audit of homelessness spending, and expanded mental health and addiction treatment. In education, she supports parental rights, school choice, and auditing spending so money reaches classrooms.
